name: Medifoxamine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France and Morocco, first in 1999 — for liver harm

similar.name: Phenoxypropazine
problems: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1966 — for liver harm

similar.name: Propoxyphene
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 5 other countries, first in 2009 — for heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Medifoxamine was removed from the market in France and Morocco starting in 1999 due to liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a low score of 16 for liver concerns and a high score of 71 for heart concerns [M]. Similar drugs have also been taken off the market, including Phenoxypropazine in the United Kingdom for liver harm and Propoxyphene in the United States and five other countries for heart harm [4][5].
